name: claude-devkit
description: Skills, agents, guidelines, and MCP integrations for Claude Code — PR review, document writing, self-review, diagram generation, and more

plugins.name: devkit-full
plugins.description: Full claude-devkit: all skills, agents, and guidelines. This is the recommended install.

plugins.name: devkit-guidelines
plugins.description: Coding and document guidelines only (required dependency for most skills)

plugins.name: devkit-agents
plugins.description: Agent definitions only (required dependency for most skills)

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Multi-agent PR code review for GitHub and Bitbucket. Requires: devkit-guidelines, devkit-agents.

plugins.name: pr-describe
plugins.description: Generate and post PR descriptions from code changes

plugins.name: self-review
plugins.description: Iterative self-review with lint/test/build validation loops. Requires: devkit-guidelines, devkit-agents.

plugins.name: blog
plugins.description: Write, review, or update blog posts with narrative structure. Requires: devkit-guidelines, devkit-agents.

plugins.name: article
plugins.description: Write, review, or update deep technical articles. Requires: devkit-guidelines, devkit-agents.

plugins.name: project-docs
plugins.description: Write, review, or update project documentation from codebase scanning. Requires: devkit-guidelines, devkit-agents.

plugins.name: doc-write
plugins.description: General-purpose document writer with diagrams and research. Requires: devkit-guidelines, devkit-agents.

plugins.name: doc-review
plugins.description: Multi-agent document review for Confluence and Google Docs. Requires: devkit-guidelines, devkit-agents.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Universal review orchestrator — auto-detects PR or document. Requires: devkit-guidelines, devkit-agents.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Deep web research with citations and multi-agent execution. Requires: devkit-agents.

plugins.name: slack-compose
plugins.description: Compose and send Slack messages with context awareness

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Generate 5 design variations with interactive selection

plugins.name: create-skill
plugins.description: Create new skills with iterative quality loops built in

plugins.name: validate-mcp
plugins.description: Test MCP server connections and OAuth flows
